payload.title: Data Parade pilot: register with Prospectus, site configuration, then flip the CLI client and authorize flags first
payload.description:
Repo: **DataParade-newsroom** (owned by the "DataParade.anth.us implementation" session; coordinate with it before opening a PR) with the Papyrus tasks of this epic. Ryan 2026-10-31: Data Parade is the pilot site for Prospectus enrollment because it is a real client site. CMS host dataparade.anth.us, console at `/newsroom`.

## Steps, in order
1. **Registration input (kanbus-275596, Prospectus side).** Run the federation packet script (PPY packet task) for Data Parade read-only; hand the packet to the Prospectus session outside git. The registration needs from Papyrus: the `prospectus-google-only` client id (`custom.prospectusSignIn.clientId` in the site's `amplify_outputs.json`), the user-pool issuer, the IAM role that will call Prospectus (the app-shell compute role and the CLI pages/enroll Lambda role: verify read-only with `aws iam get-role` which roles execute `app/cli/*` routes and the pages Lambda; if they differ, the registration lists one `roleArn` and an `executionDelegation`, or the roles are unified in Papyrus first: report), the product `papyrus-dataparade`, audience editor (not public-reader).
2. **Site configuration PR (DataParade-newsroom).** `infra/site.json`: `prospectusAccountsApiStageArn` (the central API stage ARN the role gets `execute-api:Invoke` on; the value comes from the Prospectus session, stored in site config, never in Papyrus), `cliRemoteLogin: true` if not already, `featureFlags.cliOnFederationClient: false` and `featureFlags.prospectusAuthorize: false` (flipped in steps 4 and 5), `PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS` unchanged. Bump to the Papyrus release that carries the enrollment, account and authorize tasks (four pins match). Env for the pages Lambda / routes: `PROSPECTUS_ACCOUNTS_API` endpoint (set by the app shell from the stage ARN; Papyrus enrollment task defines it).
3. **Verify the registration** read-only: `papyrus login` on Data Parade with the flag OFF -> `papyrus whoami` shows Enrolled: no, Client: main (expected). The Prospectus `/v1/identities/me` returns `{"person": null}` for this login.
4. **CLI client flip** after kanbus-b91466 approves Data Parade's review: `cliOnFederationClient: true` -> deploy -> `papyrus login --print-client` shows the federation client -> `papyrus login` enrolls -> `whoami` shows the Person. Then remove `/cli/callback` from the main client (Papyrus task step).
5. **Authorize flip**: `prospectusAuthorize: true` after Ryan's account for Data Parade is entitled to `papyrus-dataparade` (Prospectus operator grant, kanbus-592fbb if needed for the pilot, or the account's creation product) -> an account-scoped command succeeds with the account selected, and fails closed with `account_required` without it. Record every observation on this task with timestamps; no ids.
6. Only then do the other six sites get their packets reviewed and flags flipped (one site PR each, same order of steps).

## Gherkin
The behaviour lives in the Papyrus tasks; this task's evidence is the recorded live run. DataParade-newsroom's own tests assert the site config shape (flags present, pins matching).

## Acceptance
Data Parade enrolled end to end; whoami shows person and account; authorize on; the sequence written up as the runbook section "Enrolling a site" in Papyrus `docs/cli-login.md` (docs task). Depends on: the packet task (ready now), kanbus-275596, kanbus-b91466 (Data Parade), the enrollment/account/authorize/whoami tasks released. No AWS writes by the implementer; every change goes through the DataParade-newsroom pipeline.
